notes:
- Sign-in moves to your device's browser: AniList and Discord both open in the browser you already use instead of a page inside AniSequel, and the app no longer ships a web view at all.
- The official Discord mark: the Discord card, the log-in control and the preview dock draw Discord's published brand glyph instead of a hand-drawn lookalike.
- One Discord client, and a log-out that closes it: the Settings page and the app-root publisher now share one client, so logging out ends the live session immediately and a slow connect can no longer leave the page saying Connecting for the full timeout.
- The cover accent follows the app's theme, not the phone's: the title page's backdrop and the Now matching this anime swatch no longer pick their tone from a mode you are not looking at.
- Richer anime palettes: the surfaces carry more of the cover's hue, with every text pair still on Material's tone ladder, and the cover swatch is a three-tone gradient centred on the accent the buttons use.
- A cascading recolour: a theme change moves the accent roles first while the large surfaces settle on a softer spring behind them.
- Discord tokens paste cleanly: Bearer and Bot prefixes are stripped whatever case they arrive in.
- A timer that sleeps when the app is not on screen: the presence card's elapsed clock stops with the window.
